fact: EBC communications officer Mbonisi Bhembe said eligible Imbali and the public can now register to vote at Mbangweni, and that the registration process uses biometric technology to capture information.

EBC Deputy Chairperson Sipho Tembe said the EBC is rolling out Continuous Voter Registration using computers and biometric systems ahead of the 2028 elections, with the biometric system intended to prevent duplicate registration.
The EBC says a preliminary voter's register is sent to the chiefdoms for validation, where registered voters can verify their details and a copy of the register is kept for a specific period.
The EBC says over 15,000 Emaswati had registered to vote by 13 October 2026 through electronic voter registration, including by mobile phone and registration corners.
